sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Drip-Out - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Heyo, brother. Got a new job for you. So, I've got an opportunity to open a new production line, but the problem is that some hustlers are hustling where they shouldn't hustle, and all the supplies I wanted to put into circulation have been scattered all over the city because of those pricks. Help me out, big guy?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 100 Raiders
- Hand over 50 found in raid WARTECH brand equipment

sections.heading: BEAR Exclusive
sections.text:
- Unlocks purchase of BEAR Classic clothing at Ragman LL2
- Unlocks purchase of BEAR Reitar clothing at Ragman LL2

sections.heading: USEC Exclusive
sections.text:
- Unlocks purchase of USEC AC Ranger Green upper clothing at Ragman LL2
- Unlocks purchase of USEC AC Ranger Green lower clothing at Ragman LL2

"Tremendous! The drip is now real."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you need to kill 100 Scav Raiders and hand over 50 pieces of WARTECH brand equipment with found in raid status.

| Item name |
| WARTECH MK3 TV-104 chest rig (MultiCam) |
| WARTECH TV-109 + TV-106 chest rig (A-TACS FG) |
| WARTECH TV-115 plate carrier (Olive Drab) |
| WARTECH TV-110 plate carrier (Coyote) |
| WARTECH Berkut BB-102 backpack (A-TACS FG) |
